# Looking Back

## Solving One Problem at a Time

Throughout this course, Proto's descendants faced many challenges.

| Challenge | Evolution's Solution |
|-----------|----------------------|
| Staying together | Cell membrane |
| Exchanging materials | Selectively permeable membrane |
| Mechanical protection | Cell wall |
| Organizing many activities | Organelles |
| Preserving information | DNA and nucleus |
| Continuing life | Cell division |

Every new structure solved a problem that had appeared during evolution.
